services.desc: Located on 90 private beautiful acres in the country, in Northern Maine. We can accommodate small intimate weddings or up to 250 people for a sit down dinner depending on setup/design/event. Our monitor style barn is over 5,500 sq. ft. It feature 23' ceilings in the center, large front carport and a side awning overlooking the wedding pavilion. It is not only spacious, but also full of all the country charm you could desire for your special day. The covered 40'x72' pavilion is ideal for your outside wedding protecting you and your guests from the weather. It has window panel sides that can be added during inclement weather.
